system.description:
You manifest a medium sized bubble of water that you then summon a swarm of shark like piranhas within. The Water Shark has the listed statistics found on its stat block in the Summon Stat Blocks section.

You may command the Water Shark as a bonus action on your turn. The Water Shark may take an appropriate reaction if able, such as attack of opportunity. The Water Shark uses your Ninjutsu Attack bonus for its attacks and your Save DC for all of its effects save DC’s.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
